title: Validating Political Position Predictions of Arguments
reasoning: The paper focuses on the validation of political position and ideological stance predictions (left-right wing spectrum) in argumentative discourse using LLMs. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or spiritual traditions. The inclusion of an 'Ethical Considerations' section refers to the procedural ethics of human annotation (compensation and anonymity of crowdworkers) rather than benchmarking ethical or moral systems.
